answer: Counterparty-diversity bond: each identity locks 70 credits and trades with 8 distinct counterparties per epoch at the haven market, trades key-signed on the horizon ledger. A beacon samples one counterparty, replays its trades; under 8 partners or a shared cluster burns it. Attestations cost 30, rising 3 per fake: 1,000 fakes pay 12,228,000, lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. Shared counterparties expose a rented ring. Honest agents pay 240 once.
